# Blewett

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mrs. Peter Blewett is a small woman with a shrewish face. She has a very lean build, lacking any superfluous flesh on her bones.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## Personality

Blewett is known for a notable lack of generosity. Discharged servant girls have recounted fearsome tales regarding her stingy nature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## Traits

- presumed stingy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)</sub>
